Markets.title: Donald Trump bought up to $50,000 worth SpaceX shares in June, financial disclosure shows
Markets.summary: In June, financial disclosures revealed that U.S. President Donald Trump purchased up to $50,000 in SpaceX shares following its initial public offering. The president's investment portfolio is managed independently by third-party institutions.

Markets.title: Gold rallies past three-month high as Treasury buyback and weak dollar boost demand
Markets.summary: Gold prices hit a three-month high on Monday, driven by a weaker U.S. dollar and a Treasury buyback. The rally was further supported by technical buying and strong inflows into exchange-traded funds.

Markets.title: Sebi drops proceedings against Max Financial, Axis Bank in Max Life deal case
Markets.summary: Markets regulator SEBI has dropped proceedings against Max Financial Services and Axis Bank entities regarding a Max Life insurance deal. SEBI concluded that allegations of disclosure lapses and fraud from FY10 to FY22 were not established.

Markets.title: India's house price growth slows to 3.6% in Q1 FY27: RBI
Markets.summary: India's annual house price growth slowed to 3.6% in the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, down from 4.5% in the previous quarter. Despite this yearly deceleration, the All-India House Price Index rose 1.1% from the prior quarter, driven largely by contributions from Chandigarh and Lucknow.

Markets.title: SoftBank pares nearly 2.6% stake in Lenskart for Rs 2,888 crore
Markets.summary: SoftBank Group sold a 2.6% stake in Lenskart for Rs 2,888 crore through a block deal involving multiple institutional investors. This transaction reduced SoftBank's holding in the company from 9.86% to 7.28%.

Geo-Political.title: Iran faces 'greatest financial offensive ever', says US treasury secretary
Geo-Political.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced that the United States will sever all economic ties with Iran in what he called its greatest financial offensive ever. He added that any nation partnering financially with Iran will also face international isolation.

Geo-Political.title: UK PM Burnham vows support for Ukraine despite 'outrageous threats' from Russia
Geo-Political.summary: UK Prime Minister Burnham has pledged continued support for Ukraine following Russian warnings of consequences over the reported use of British drones. Moscow had issued outrageous threats regarding UK involvement in the conflict.

Geo-Political.title: Russia's second-biggest online retailer targeted in Ukrainian strikes
Geo-Political.summary: Overnight Ukrainian strikes hit warehouses belonging to Ozon, Russia's second-biggest online retailer, in southern regions including Dagestan and Krasnodar. The company confirmed the attacks on its facilities across the area.

Geo-Political.title: Israel warns of 'forceful' response to kites flown from Gaza
Geo-Political.summary: Israel has warned of a forceful response after kites were flown from Gaza into Israeli border communities. Hamas stated that children in Gaza launched these kites.

Geo-Political.title: King of Norway's health has worsened, palace says
Geo-Political.summary: The palace announced that the health of Norway's King Harald has worsened. He remains hospitalized while receiving antibiotics for a bacterial infection in his bloodstream.

Geo-Political.title: Outrage in Nepal over rape and murder of three-year-old girl
Geo-Political.summary: Protests have erupted in Nepal following the rape and murder of a three-year-old girl. The victim was found dead last week, three days after she was reported missing.

AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator recently discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. This experiment highlights a shift in organic traffic generation toward AI optimization (AIO) over traditional SEO.

Data & Insights.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is reportedly considering using the department's $1 trillion General Account to fund buybacks of older, higher-yielding securities. This strategy, cited by CNBC sources, aims to manage government debt more efficiently.

Data & Insights.title: India negotiating trade deals with nations, blocs worth $15 trillion GDP: Piyush Goyal
Data & Insights.summary: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal stated that India is negotiating trade agreements with countries and blocs representing a $15 trillion GDP. Goyal is currently visiting Japan with a delegation of over 200 business representatives to strengthen bilateral trade and investment.

Data & Insights.title: Iranian rial hits record low of 2.02 million against US dollar amid threat of new Trump sanctions — Here's what we know
Data & Insights.summary: The Iranian rial dropped 4.5% to a record low of 2.02 million against the US dollar on August 24. The currency plunge followed US President Donald Trump's announcement of new economic sanctions against Tehran.

Data & Insights.title: Service producer prices index mixed in Q1; air passenger services surge 32%
Data & Insights.summary: Service producer prices showed mixed results in the first quarter of the year. During this period, the cost of air passenger services surged by 32 percent.

Data & Insights.title: AI, semicon, global value chains: How globalization isn't dying—it's evolving
Data & Insights.summary: Global trade is shifting away from physical goods toward services and strategic technologies like semiconductors and AI. Supply chains and capital investments are reconfiguring rather than disappearing, signaling an evolution in globalization.

Data & Insights.summary: This weekly compilation features data-driven charts analyzing Mint's recent reports on the Reserve Bank of India's hawkish minutes, a drought warning, and the rural workforce. These visual insights help readers delve deeper into key economic and environmental stories from the past week.

India.title: 15% Decline In Indian Students Seeking Undergraduate Courses In US: Report
India.summary: A recent report shows a 15 percent decrease in Indian students applying for undergraduate courses in the US. Despite this decline, India remains the leading source of international students for the United States.

India.title: Physical Abuse, Forced Smoking, Blackmail: Ragging Case At Gujarat Hostel
India.summary: A father reported that senior students physically abused and blackmailed his son at a Gujarat hostel. The victim was allegedly beaten, forced to do chores and give massages, and made to smoke while being filmed.

India.title: 36 Years On, Thane Man Wanted For Attacking Cricket Umpire With Bat Arrested
India.summary: A 55-year-old man living in Thane has been arrested nearly 36 years after he allegedly attacked a cricket umpire with a bat. He is currently facing a charge of attempted murder for the incident.

India.title: BJP, AAP's Sports Outreach In Big Gen Z Push In Punjab
India.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will interact with students on August 27 through the "Khelo India Samvad" programme. This event is part of a major sports outreach in Punjab by the BJP and AAP aimed at engaging Gen Z voters.

India.title: Video: Live Worm Found In Sandwich At Posh Gurugram Restaurant
India.summary: A customer at a Gurugram restaurant found a live worm in his sandwich after eating almost half of it. He recorded and uploaded a video of the incident on social media.

India.title: BJP Says Will Contest All Seats In Punjab Assembly Polls, AAP Scoffs
India.summary: The BJP announced it will contest all seats in the upcoming Punjab Assembly elections, prompting mockery from the AAP. This decision followed the arrival of BJP leader BL Santosh at the Mohali airport, where he was greeted by state party officials.

General.title: Organised crime arrests as police investigate A66 crash that killed two officers
General.summary: Police arrested 12 people for suspected organized crime involvement before a crash. The collision resulted in the deaths of seven people, including two police officers.

General.title: How the deadly A66 crash unfolded leaving seven dead
General.summary: At 03:30 BST on Saturday, a Volkswagen Passat collided with a marked police car on the A66 motorway. The crash resulted in seven deaths, including two police officers.

General.summary: Andy Burnham has pledged his continued support for Ukraine following threats from Moscow. Russia warned of unspecified consequences after reports that Ukraine used British drones.
